summary.text: April Fournier is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 114, in the November 3, 2026 general election. She has served on the Portland City Council since 2020 and is a citizen of the Navajo Nation.

paragraphs.text: April Fournier graduated from Cibola High School and earned a graduate degree from the University of Maine in 2018, and her career experience includes working as a managing director.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as Diné, a citizen of the Navajo Nation, who grew up between Arizona, Maine and New Mexico and settled in Maine for good in 2001.
She said she has raised her family in Portland since 2006 and has worked in the insurance industry, customer service, early childhood special education and community organizing.
Fournier said her campaign messages include making Maine affordable for everyone and addressing climate change.
She named affordable and accessible health care, reproductive rights, LGBTQ+ rights, tax policy, tribal sovereignty and mental health systems among her policy priorities.
